feeds.title: A Year of Reading The World
feeds.description: Ann Morgan, a UK-based author, TED speaker, Royal Literary Fund fellow, and editor, is best known for her first book, 'Reading the World' (or 'The World Between Two Covers' in the US). This work was inspired by her year-long journey through a book from every country in the world, a remarkable adventure documented on her blog. In addition to her non-fiction work, Ann is the author of two novels: 'Beside Myself' and 'Crossing Over.'

feeds.title: Diary of Difference
feeds.description: A diary of a weird girl, Ivana, full of creativity and wittiness. Her articles cover book reviews, postcards, and everything random. Mystery, Young-Adult, Contemporary, Romance are some of her favorite genres.

feeds.title: Read to Ramble
feeds.description: Read To Ramble is a blog posted by Ellie to share her passion for books, she reads fantasy, historical fiction, mysteries, children's and middle grade stories, gives reviews and shares her experience of books with the world via her blog.

feeds.title: European Literature Network s Blog
feeds.description: The European Literature Network was created with the mission of championing great writing from Europe in the UK - and doing it together. Open to writers, translators, publishers, agents, booksellers, festival directors, arts managers, and journalists, ELNet is a free, collaborative hub for sharing news and views. ELNet spreads the word about European literature and translation on its website.

feeds.title: Europe Books Blog
feeds.description: Europe Books Blog posts about interviews with writers regarding their up-coming books and novels. Europe books is an international publishing company that publishes content in various European and other world languages. They have virtual as well as authentic bookstores.

feeds.title: Book Gazette
feeds.description: My name is Nick Lüthi. I report on the books and the world of independent publishers. A podcast supplements the reviews. A list of publishers complements the website, which is regularly updated. The mission of Book Gazette is to be a pleasure-maker, a platform that encourages discovery and further searching.

feeds.title: Advice books Reviews
feeds.description: Advicesbooks is one of the four websites founded by Rosalba Mancuso, an Italian - English bilingual writer who writes and translates from English to Italian. This site has book reviews, book translations and book press releases in Italian and English to promote books internationally.

feeds.title: EU-READ&ART Blog
feeds.description: The first European digital library of book trailers. EU-READ&ART Blog creates awareness for reading while providing tips on how to read more. Their mission is to create awareness for adult learning so that they can excel in life, therefore they launch book trailers to excite youngsters for reading.
